Dear Sir/Ma’am 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 and Regulation 46 read with Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI 
(Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you 
that the audio recording of the Earnings Call on the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated 
Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, held on Friday, August 
14, 2026, has been uploaded on the website of the Company. 
The link to access the said recording is as follows: 
https://www.gaudiumivfcentre.com/audio-player/q1-fy26-27 
We request you to kindly take the same on record. 
Thanking you, 
Yours faithfully.
